svg.title: Logical Key Match
svg.desc: activity.reader = cohort_readers.reader AND a.month = (c.cohort + INTERVAL '1 month')::date. a = activity; c = cohort input. DISTINCT key: (identity, month). Identity alone is not unique. Assumes one cohort per reader; not enforced: duplicates can fan out.

g.text: Row grain: one distinct reader activity month
Row grain: one prepared reader cohort assignment
Dashed connector: query match, not an FK
not enforced: duplicates can fan out.
Key fields shown. Full field dictionary above.
